notes:
Summary: Hospitality CX platform that provides human-in-the-loop concierge for hotel chains. Evaluating Redwood for low-latency streaming agent assist (in-call suggestions, canned replies, quick search) + ticket summarization post-call.

Requirements: p95 suggestion latency <= 250ms (goal 200ms) for single-agent sessions; support bursts up to 8k concurrent agent sessions across global regions; fallback model route to cheaper quantized variant on capacity pressure; deterministic audit logs for every generated message. Need VPC option and KMS integration for keys.

Security & compliance: Will require SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO/SAML, tenant-level audit logs, data residency option for EU customers (some hotels require EU-only). Legal flagged retention policy for transcripts (30 days default, can be 90 for enterprise).

POC notes: 2-week POC started 2026-02-10. POC objectives: 1) validate streaming latency under simulated call load (ramp to 2k concurrent agent streams), 2) verify tool-calling workflow to CRM (Zendesk/Ticketing), 3) confirm audit_log fidelity and KMS integration.

Quotes / verbal: "We need suggestions before the agent finishes typing — latency is everything for our ops." — Head of CX Ops.

Ops constraints: Agents use on-prem SIP gateway; ideal path is regional edge + smart routing to nearest Redwood region. Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput once POC passes. Cost sensitivity moderate; willing to commit if unit token economics and autoscaling guarantees hold.

Artifacts: drive deck + latency runbook attached (drive:/decks/stonehaven-poc-latency-runbook-v3.pdf). Security review thread in Gmail (thread-CAJxQx0zS123bx@example.com). Jira SEC-704 opened for encryption questions.

Internal notes: SE (Maya) to run extended latency sweep w/ batching disabled and KV cache warm; AE (Jordan) to push SLA/contract template week of 2026-03-15. CSM (Carlos) prepping onboarding checklist for Dedicated migration.

Next immediate: schedule legal intro, deliver SOC2 artifacts, run 48h high-churn spike test (simulate holiday booking surge).
